display.$description: the headline and the prompt sentence

prose.$description: UI and explanation. Same family as display; the hierarchy is carried by scale and weight, not by a second neutral sans.

read.$description: sustained reading, and the whole ebook interior

notation.$description: the blank notation (n), figures, and meta. Same superfamily as the sans, so the shift is register rather than brand.

written.$description: what was filled into a blank reads heavier than the printed sentence around it

control.$description: a thing you press, as opposed to a thing that is printed

motion.$description: Quality only. What moves, in what order, and what it means is choreography, and choreography lives in DESIGN.md as prose because it is a judgment and not a value (ENGINE §3).
